title: Being accountable: Elsecar Colliery Ledger 1796
lineage: Museum interpretation of the 1796 ledger. Attribution of the engine account to the surviving Newcomen pump is explicitly an assumption; the local web-rendered excerpt contains this page plus a Heritage Gateway redirect, not the indexed historical gateway record.
